question:
Find the appropriate word that can replace the ?. Which one of the following word logically completes the series

Select the most logical sequence: Panchayat, Block, District, State
solution: This sequence represents the **hierarchical structure of administrative governance** in India (specifically the Panchayati Raj and state administration system), arranged in ascending order from the smallest unit to the largest: • **Panchayat:** Governance at the village level (smallest). •
